name: Усунення захисника (2)
description:
You have learned some smart ways to get rid of a defender. In this lesson, you have to remove a defender to win a piece. It is up to you to figure out how you can get rid of the guard..

What do you have to do?

Remove a defender to win a piece and answer the question.

puzzles.pgn: {(%cal Ge6f5,Ge6d5)} {Q=1} 1. Bxf5 (1. Rxd5? Bxh3) 1... exf5 2. Rxd5 *
texts: Find a way to lure the defender away.
